brief.note: Requests quote this hash. If the brief changes, the hash in each request changes with it and old requests are void.

contract.model: gpt-image-2.6 only (gpt-image-2.6-sunburst permitted for precision facets). No fallback model. If gpt-image-2.6 is unavailable the job is BLOCKED, not substituted.
contract.retakes: A retake is a NEW job id with a new bounded brief from the design lead. Never an unrecorded retry.
contract.storage: Raw/intermediate PNGs: private staging only (D-08). Nothing generated enters gaia-skill-heaven until founder approval. Approved deliverables land as WebP under packages/site/src/assets/lucy/landing/ in a later commit that cites the approval.
contract.transparency: Request transparent output; if the generator returns opaque, the prompt has already asked for a flat #00FF00 field and the matte goes through scripts/assets/lucy-matte-guard.py. Never purple/magenta chroma. Never a painted checkerboard.
contract.receipts: Each candidate gets a receipt with model, full prompt, input references (path + sha256), raw hash, outputs, dimensions, alpha audit, self-review, and pass/fail per acceptance criterion.
contract.noCharacter: No job in this manifest draws Lucy. Character pixels come only from the approved v5 masters. LR-G05 is the single exception and is NOT issued.

stylePreamble: Isolated pieces of a single shattered pane of thin optical crystal glass, photographed as product macro on a perfectly flat pure #00FF00 chroma-green field with no shadow, no floor, no reflection of the background. Each shard is a clean, sharp-edged, faceted sliver — long, tapering, asymmetric, with one or two polished bevels — never a feather, membrane, petal, leaf, ice cube, or gem cut. Light passes through the glass and splits at the bevels into thin, distinct bands of spectral color (violet, blue, cyan, mint, rose, magenta) as narrow lines along the edges, never as a wash over the whole shard. Interiors are mostly clear with soft internal caustics and a bright white specular glint on one edge. Hairline-crisp edges suitable for alpha extraction. No text, no logo, no watermark, no frame, no hands, no people, no character, no scenery.

jobs.name: Heaven ordered shard set
jobs.purpose: Loose foreground glass around the Stage in Heaven, plus the glint shards on section transitions. Gives the prototype real refraction the procedural stand-ins cannot fake.

canonReferences.use: glass-wing material and edge language (shipped hero effect layer)
heaven.wings = ordered blue/cyan shard wings; wingType = independent floating prism/glass shards

jobs.promptScaffold:
<stylePreamble>

Heaven set — ORDER. Eight separate shards laid out in two rows of four with wide empty green gutters between every piece (at least one-tenth of the canvas between neighbours). All eight share ONE dominant long-axis angle of about 72 degrees from horizontal, like panes from the same wing, varying in length from 1:3 to 1:7 aspect. Saturated cyan-blue glass (#7CC4FF to #37D6E0 family) with the spectral split only along their long bevels. Calm, aligned, precise.
jobs.composition: Sheet of 8 isolated shards, 2×4 grid, wide gutters, shared long-axis angle.
jobs.generationSize: the largest 3:2 landscape size the gpt-image-2.6 endpoint supports, long edge ≥ 2048px

delivery.format: 8 individual WebP files, lossless alpha, plus shards.json (id, bbox, longAxisDeg, facetSide)
delivery.dimensions: each shard long edge 768px (desktop), with a 384px derivative (mobile)
delivery.transparency: real alpha, no green in the exterior partial-alpha band, no green spill in the 2px interior boundary
delivery.budget: ≤ 120 KB per desktop shard, ≤ 40 KB per mobile shard

jobs.desktopMobile: Desktop uses 5–7 at once around the Stage; mobile uses ≤ 2 small shards in the arrival plate.
acceptance: Reads as one pane of glass shattered, not as gems, ice, crystals-in-a-cave, or feathers
All shards share one long-axis angle within ±4°
Spectral colour only as edge bands; interiors clear
Clean alpha: lucy-matte-guard passes; white/black/grey/checker previews show no halo or green fringe
At 120px on screen each shard still shows a readable bevel and one specular glint
No text, frame, people or character

jobs.name: Ultra gold-prismatic shard set
jobs.purpose: Loose foreground glass in Ultra: the crown of shards that rises around the Stage.

canonReferences.use: gold shard fans in the master — material, gold interference, edge treatment (reference only; never cropped into the deliverable)
ultra.wings = gold-prismatic shard wings; accentRange #FFD24A–#F7C84B; never inverted

jobs.promptScaffold:
<stylePreamble>

Ultra set — CROWN. Seven separate shards with wide empty green gutters. They fan outward like the points of a crown: each one's long axis points away from a shared centre below the sheet, angles spread from 60 to 120 degrees. Clear glass with gold interference (#FFD24A to #F7C84B) as thin iridescent banding along the bevels, a warm white specular glint, and on ONE edge of each shard a very thin red-crimson leading line (#C81E1E) no wider than the glint. Regal, decisive, never orange, never brass.
forbidden: turning the red edge into a fill
jobs.composition: Sheet of 7 isolated shards fanned around an implied centre below the sheet.
jobs.generationSize: the largest 3:2 landscape size the endpoint supports, long edge ≥ 2048px

delivery.format: 7 individual WebP files, lossless alpha, plus shards.json
delivery.transparency: real alpha, same guard as LR-G01

jobs.desktopMobile: Desktop crown of 5–7 above/around her head on the Stage; mobile ≤ 2.
acceptance: Gold reads as light interference on clear glass, not metal
Red appears only as a hairline leading edge
Fan reads as a crown when the seven are placed on their original angles
Clean alpha, guard passes, no green fringe
Sits beside the v5 Ultra master without a material clash (side-by-side review on #1b1a1c)

jobs.name: Hell fragmented inverted shard set
jobs.purpose: Loose foreground glass in Hell. Canon: Hell is the exact RGB inversion of Heaven, and its shards are highly fragmented.
consumer: LucyStage › loose-glass plane (Hell, on the paper stage)
jobs.method: Deterministic: for each Heaven shard, split along 1–3 fracture lines (seeded, recorded) into 2–4 fragments offset by 2–10px and rotated ±3°; then exact full-foreground RGB inversion with byte-identical alpha. Never recolour after inversion.

delivery.format: WebP lossless alpha + shards.json with fracture seeds

acceptance: Inversion report proves full RGB inversion + identical alpha
Fragments read as broken from one Heaven shard, not as new shapes
On paper #efece7 the edges read as rust/umber/olive light, no hand-placed red
Guard run in --exact-inverted-hell mode only after the source report passes

jobs.name: Wing-fragment divider (derive first)
jobs.purpose: A horizontal strip of broken wing glass between §03 and §04 (the approach to the peak). Heaven/Ultra only; none in Zero.
jobs.method: Crop the outer third of each wing, rotate to horizontal, mirror is ALLOWED for the wing effect layer only (it is not character art), composite into a 3200×400 strip with real alpha.
acceptance: No visible seam at the centre join
Reads as glass fragments, not feathers
Clean alpha on charcoal and on paper
jobs.fallback: If acceptance fails, the design lead may issue LR-G03.

jobs.name: Mobile state plates (performance derivative)
jobs.purpose: Smaller mobile arrival plates so phones do not download the 2048×3072 masters. The prototype uses CSS crops of the existing masters until these exist.
jobs.method: Deterministic crop + Lanczos resize, alpha preserved, no colour change, never mirrored. Crop window keeps face core, both eyes / tear, ribbon, and at least one katana guard.
acceptance: Pixel-diff vs master shows no change beyond resampling
Tear present and continuous in Hell/Ultra
Zero carries nothing added

jobs.name: Prismatic caustic light plate
jobs.purpose: Only if the procedural split light fails design acceptance: a faint caustic pattern cast by her glass, used at 6–10% opacity behind the stage.
jobs.promptScaffold: Abstract caustic light pattern cast on a matte near-black floor by light passing through broken prismatic glass: thin bright filaments and soft spectral fringes, mostly dark, no objects visible, no text. Seamlessly tileable left to right.
acceptance: Reads as light, not texture or noise
Tileable horizontally
Invisible cost at 8% opacity on mid mobile
